params.name: campaignId
params.description: The unique identifier of the campaign to report on.

params.name: startDate
params.description: Report start date in YYYY-MM-DD format.

params.name: endDate
params.description: Report end date in YYYY-MM-DD format.

params.name: dimensions
params.description: Comma-separated list of dimensions to include in the report. Options include campaign, ad_set, ad, country, platform, channel.

params.name: metrics
params.description: Comma-separated list of metrics to include. Options include impressions, clicks, spend, ctr, cpc, conversions, conversion_value.

items.docs: Retrieve customizable performance report data for a specific campaign in CSV format. Supports filtering by date range, granularity, and selection of dimensions and metrics including impressions, clicks, spend, and conversions.
